name: GraphQL Formatter
summary: Pretty-print or minify GraphQL queries and schemas locally — nested selection sets, arguments, and strings.
description: Paste a GraphQL operation or schema document to format with indentation, or minify to a single line. Strings and comments are preserved. Lightweight formatter — not a full GraphQL parser or validator.

faqs.question: Does this validate against a schema?
faqs.answer: No. It only formats document structure. Invalid GraphQL may still pretty-print imperfectly.

faqs.question: Are string literals safe?
faqs.answer: Yes. Quoted strings and block strings are protected so braces inside them are not treated as structure.

faqs.question: Is anything uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Formatting runs entirely in your browser.
